 Here are the Predictions for YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026, 64th Match (Super 8) - Warriors vs Boland and 65th Match (Super 8) - Eastern Storm vs Dolphins, to be played on the 5th of November at the St. George's Park, Port Elizabeth and Kingsmead, Durban.
 Match Prediction - Warriors (SA) v Rocks 
 LIVE SCORES - 64th Match (Super 8) - Warriors vs Boland (St. George's Park, Port Elizabeth) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at St. George's Park, Port Elizabeth (CSA T20 Challenge) - 152
 Average 2nd Innings Total at St. George's Park, Port Elizabeth (CSA T20 Challenge) - 136
 Current Form Warriors:
 In the Super 8's, Warriors are currently placed at the 2nd position with 3 wins to their credit. They have 16 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jordan Hermann with 203 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Thomas Kaber with 12 scalps under his belt .
 Warriors have won their previous match against Western Province by 4 wickets.
 Western Province batted first and they posted a total of 130 for 8 in 20 overs. Jiveshan Pillay, Kashief Joseph, Joshua Van Heerden and Valentine Kitime all threw it away quite early into the innings. Daniel Smith was the lone warrior. He kept fighting against the odds as wickets kept falling in regular succession. Smith scored 67 runs but failed to take Western Province to a respectable total. They were eventually restricted to an under par score of 130 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Warriors lost the key wicket of Sibonelo Makhanya quite early. After his dismissal, Jordan Hermann and Matthew de Villiers revived the innings with a stand of 33 runs for the 2nd wicket partnership. Matthew de Villiers made 28 while Hermann scored 25 quick runs. There were hiccups in the middle overs with Oliver Whitehead picked up 5 scalps. However, JP King and Thomas Kaber had their back. King made 32 while Kaber scored 14 runs. Both stayed not out and helped Warriors get over the line in the 17th over itself with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Boland: 
 In the Super 8's, Boland are currently placed at the 3rd position with 3 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 12 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Gavin Kaplan with 289 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Imran Manack with 10 scalps under his belt .
 Boland have won their previous match against Dolphins by 7 wickets.
 Dolphins batted first and they posted a total of 174 for 4 in 20 overs. The start was terrible as Romashan Pillay, Bryce Parsons and Jason Smith all got out without troubling the scorers much. Dolphins were reduced to 12 for 3 in the 4th over itself. After that phase, Ntando Zuma and Hanu Viljoen took the responsibility of taking Dolphins to a competitive total. Zuma made 42 while Hanu Viljoen went on to score 114 runs in only 59 deliveries as Dolphins managed to reach 174 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Blayde Capell and Gavin Kaplan gave Boland a dream start. Kaplan made 55 runs in 44 balls while Capell scored 90 runs in only 53 deliveries to seal the deal in favor of Boland. Lehan Botha also contributed healthily and Boland comfortably got over the line in the last over with 7 wickets in hand.

 Current Form Eastern Storm:

 The top run scorer for Eastern Storm in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jurie Snyman with 276 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Eastern Storm in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Aryan Gopalam with 7 scalps under his belt .
 Eastern Storm have lost their previous match against South Western Districts by 6 wickets.
 Eastern Storm batted first and they posted a total of 144 for 7 in 20 overs. Kabelo Sekhukhune and Ronan Hermann started off quite slow for Eastern Storm. They used up way too many deliveries in the Powerplay overs and looked in troubled waters. Christopher Britz and Jurie Snyman got the starts but they also threw it away when it mattered the most. Leo Sadler was the star of the show with the ball in hand. He picked up 3 wickets for only 16 runs and helped restrict Eastern Storm to 144 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Yaseen Vallie and Janneman Malan batted superbly in the Powerplay overs. Janneman Malan in particular was simply sensational with the bat. Vallie made 26 while Malan scored 75 runs off 57 balls to seal the deal in favor of South Western Districts. Liam Alder also played a whirlwind cameo of 18 runs in only 4 balls and helped South Western Districts get over the line in the 19th over with 6 wickets in hand.
